title: Page 7
content_zh:
“起来啦。”她一推他的肩。
于季友抬头，看见她娇羞欣喜的模样，突然间觉得，偶尔丢一次脸也没什么大不了的。
两人眼神对上，他轻揉她哭肿的脸，忍不住笑了。
“笑什么！啊……”普宁话还没说完，就被他拦腰抱起。“你的背－－”
“我没事。”他拍拍她要她安静，然后说：“各位，给我半个时辰。胡里，守住门口，不许任何人来打扰。”
“包在小的身上。”胡里咚咚咚地跑到候着。
直到这时，众人才一一回神。
好像，看到了很不得了的事！
“好了好了，”李进笑着招呼底下人。“都听见驸马爷的话了，大伙儿松口气休息一下吧。”
“快放我下来－－你这家伙，忘了背还伤着啊！”
“这样比较快。”他身一顶，就把她压制在门后。
看着她哭肿的眼睛，他心疼极了。“昨晚是我不对，我不该答应带霍香走，我其实没那个意思，但被你一气，我的话就溜出来了。”
“之前呢？你还当着我面护着她！”
“我那时不知道你在吃醋。听我说，我从头到尾没把霍香放心上，所以才不知道我的反应会造成那么大的误会。”
“她刚才还站在你后边。”
“我没看见她。”这真的是冤枉。“昨天我请李进转达的话你没收到？我说我不带她走了，她如果想离开翠岭村我愿意帮忙，但不是带她回襄州。”
她嘴一抿，承认道：“昨晚李进有试图说过，但我不让他提。”
“唉！”他一声长叹。真叫造化弄人，要她昨晚早听见这消息，她也不用哭得两眼肿得跟核桃一样。
“我瞒了你一件事。”他想他大概就是瞒了这个，才会引发后头那么多事。“前天傍晚，我曾央霍家兄妹搀我去偷看你，我看见你切菜时划伤手，我很心疼，所以才会请霍香过来帮忙。我知道你很努力，也很有天分，但我就是……”舍不得。
这话他前晚说过，她瞄他一眼，所以说，真的是她误会了？！

“你真的没喜欢她？”
“皇天在上，”他高举右手。“你要我拿性命作担保都行。我发誓我从没喜欢过霍香，要不是因为你，我压根儿不会注意到她。”
她嘟起嘴，谁教他不把话讲清楚！开头回来就看见霍香端着粥菜进门，还有他口口声声维护她的模样，更是教她气坏了。
“我是因为她抢了我最擅长的事，我才生气的么！”她终于愿意承认，她所以不开心，是害怕自己再也派不上用场。“你又不是不知道我会做的事情不多，我好努力想让你觉得我很能干，可是跟霍香一比，我就像三岁娃儿在扮家家一样，一点都不厉害。”
“我从没拿你跟她比过。”他端起她羞窘掺杂的俏脸。“你对我做的一切我都看在眼里，尤其跟储大娘聊过，我越是觉得你难得。你在多短时间内，从一个什么都不懂的娇贵公主，变成一个任劳任怨的苹儿姑娘；换作霍香，你觉得她肯么？”
“不能这么比。”她不再是之前的普宁，已经懂得分辨了。“在我，那些事不过偶一为之，但她，却是想逃也逃不了的必要，份量不一样。”
他摇头，“既然都知道摆在一块比不公平，为什么还要巴巴地跟着她比？”
“人家……吃味么。”她低头搓玩自己的指头。
因为喜欢他，才会害怕不如人，这等幽微心思，可是向来骄傲自信的她不曾体会的。
初次尝，当然吓坏了。
“看看你－－”他端起她脸，细瞧她哭肿的眼睛。“为了一桩莫须有的事，哭成了这模样，都不知道看在我眼里，多难受。”
“我哪知道是误会。”她昨晚掉的每滴眼泪可都是货真价实，每每一哭，她就觉得心又破碎了一大块。“我一想到你喜欢霍香更胜喜欢我，我脑子就空了，什么事都想不清楚了。”
“你可以来问我。”
“我来啦，可你又当着我的面说要带她走。”她嗔道。
“对不起。”他牵起她手道歉。“这点真的是我的错，我想我一定是哪句话让她误会了，但我保证，跟她相处的每一亥，我脑子里都是你。”
他这么一说，普宁心就软了。“也不能全怪你，我想一想，我昨晚口气确实也不对……”
“你能要打翻醋坛的人有多好口气？”
还敢糗她！普宁轻捶他胸。“你以为你在跟谁说话？”
他瞅着她直笑。“当然是跟我的好公主、我的好娘子说话。”
贫嘴！普宁红着脸扭开身，他立刻伸手圈住她。

第9章(2)
“别生我气了？”
“再说。”她睨他，眸里满是风情。
“要怎样才肯原谅我？”他脸凑得极近。
“这个么－－”
他看见她黑眼珠滴溜地转了圈，不等她吐出答案，他突然凑唇吻住她。
“你慢慢想，我先做我想做的事。”他贴着她呢喃，在她照着动作时，缓缓将舌探入。
等她想起惩罚他的方法，怕天都黑了。
她抱住他，在他每个细腻的探索间发出迷醉的呻吟。她当真以为，这一辈子，她再也尝不到他的吻……
一滴感激的泪珠溢出她眼，他以舌舔去，再紧紧、紧紧地抱住她。
“别哭。”他以鼻轻蹭她脸颊。“你是适合笑的，你不晓得，每次见你流泪，我的心都会痛。”
“我是喜极而泣。”她看着他的眼蒙眬而甜蜜。“我好高兴我们能解开误会、好高兴你没喜欢上霍香、好高兴听你喊我娘子……”
“你喜欢听，我就每天喊给你听。”他唇贴在她耳畔一次一次低语：“我的娘子，我的小苹儿……”
“还有一句话。”她揪住他衣袖。“我还要你再说一次。”
他知道是哪句话，铁打的汉子脸红了。
“我喜欢你，早在我吻你那一刻，你就该知道了。”
“那很早耶。”她忍不住说：“我们在山洞那一晚，你就趁着我喂你喝水，一下把我吻得七荤八素了。”
有这回事？！他脸一热。“那……八成那时候，我就喜欢你了吧。”
普宁乐晕了。
“我也是，从那一晚开始，我就好喜欢好喜欢你。”她脸直蹭着他胸口。“以前龙焱说我一定会遇上我喜欢的人，我还不相信。我现在终于知道他说得没错。喜欢上人，也被人喜欢的感觉真是好极了－－”

他忍不住问：“谁是龙焱？”
“就京里城门前‘一条龙’的掌杓啊－－”她没多想就答，不过一瞧见他眯紧的眼，她立刻噤口，感觉好像嗅到醋味了？！
“他什么时候跟你说这些话？”
“一回父王要他进宫烹馔，我跟他就聊了一下……”
“他长得很俊？”不经安排，一个掌杓的厨子能跟公主说上话？于季友的表情很不是滋味。
“嗯……”该怎么答呢？龙焱跟他，一是俊美一是剽悍，两个是不一样的好看。
“不准你在脑里想他！”他恨恨地啃着她嘴。
“光想都不行，不知道谁先前还说要带个女人在身边……”她故意逗他。
“我说过对不起了。”
“终于知道吃味的感觉多难受了吧？”直到他不满地点头，她才笑着搂住他脖子。“放心，为妻的我，一颗心全在夫君身上，以前的事不说，但保证从今以后，我再不瞧任何男人。”
“我也不会给你机会瞧。从现在开始，你的人你的心你的眼都是我的，再不许你说什么退婚要嫁别人的事。”
content_en:
"Get up." She pushed his shoulder.
Yu Jiyou looked up and saw her shy and happy look, and suddenly felt that it was no big deal to lose face once in a while.
Their eyes met, and he gently rubbed her face that was swollen from crying, and couldn't help but smile.
"What are you laughing at! Ah..." Before Puning could finish speaking, he was picked up by him. "Your back-"
"I'm fine." He patted her to be quiet, and then said, "Everyone, give me half an hour. Hu Li, guard the door and don't allow anyone to disturb you."
"Put it on the little one." Hu Li ran to wait.
It was only then that everyone came back to their senses one by one.
It seemed like I had seen something extraordinary!
"Okay, okay," Li Jin greeted the people below with a smile. "We have all heard what the Prince Consort said. Let's all relax and take a rest."
"Put me down quickly - you guy, you forgot and your back is still hurt!"
"It's faster this way." With one push, he suppressed her behind the door.
Looking at her eyes that were swollen from crying, he felt very sad. "It was my fault last night. I shouldn't have agreed to take Huo Xiang away. I actually didn't mean that, but when you were angry, my words slipped out."
"What about before? You were still protecting her in front of me!"
"I didn't know you were jealous at the time. Listen to me, I didn't take Huo Xiang into account from the beginning to the end, so I didn't know that my reaction would cause such a big misunderstanding."
"She was standing behind you just now."
"I didn't see her." This is really an injustice. "You didn't receive what I asked Li Jin to convey yesterday? I said I would leave without taking her. If she wants to leave Cuiling Village, I am willing to help, but I will not take her back to Xiangzhou."
She pursed her lips and admitted, "Li Jin tried to say it last night, but I didn't let him mention it."
"Alas!" He sighed. What a trick of fate. If she had heard the news last night, she wouldn't have cried until her eyes were swollen like walnuts.
"I hid something from you." He thought that he probably hid this thing, which led to so many things later. "The evening before yesterday, I asked the Huo brothers and sisters to help me take a peek at you. I saw you cut your hand while chopping vegetables. I felt very distressed, so I asked Huo Xiang to come over and help. I know you work hard and are talented, but I just..." I couldn't bear it.
He said this the night before, and she glanced at him. So, did she really misunderstand? !
"You really don't like her?"
"Your Majesty, God is above you," he raised his right hand. "You want me to pledge my life as a guarantee. I swear I have never liked Huo Xiang. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have noticed her at all."
She pouted, who taught him not to speak clearly! When she first came back, she saw Huo Xiang coming in with porridge and vegetables, and how he kept defending her, which made her even more angry.
"Am I angry because she took away what I am best at?" She was finally willing to admit that she was unhappy because she was afraid that she would no longer be useful. "It's not like you don't know that there aren't many things I can do. I try so hard to make you think I'm very capable, but compared with Huo Xiang, I'm like a three-year-old pretending to be a householder. I'm not powerful at all."
"I've never compared you with her." He picked up her pretty, embarrassed face. "I have seen everything you did to me, especially after talking to Aunt Chu. The more I think you are rare. In such a short period of time, you have gone from a delicate princess who knows nothing to a hard-working Ping'er girl. If it were Huo Xiang, do you think she would be willing to do it?"
"It can't be compared like that." She is no longer the Puning she was before, she already knows how to distinguish. "For me, those things are just accidental things, but for her, they are necessary and cannot be escaped even if she wants to. The weight is different."
He shook his head, "Since we all know that it's not fair to compete together, why do we continue to compete with her?"
"Is it... delicious?" She lowered her head and rubbed her fingers.
Because I like him, I am afraid of being inferior to others. Such subtle thoughts, but I have always been proud of myself.Believe it or not, she has never experienced it.
The first time I tried it, of course I was terrified.
"Look at you--" He lifted her face and looked closely at her eyes that were swollen from crying. "I don't know how uncomfortable it is to cry like this because of something that didn't happen."
"I didn't know it was a misunderstanding." Every tear she shed last night was genuine. Every time she cried, she felt her heart was broken again. "When I think that you like Huo Xiang more than me, my mind goes blank and I can't think of anything clearly."
"You can ask me."
"I'm here, but you said in front of me that you would take her away." She said angrily.
"I'm sorry." He held her hand and apologized. "This is really my fault. I think I must have misunderstood her with something I said, but I promise that every time I get along with her, you will be in my mind."
When he said this, Puning's heart softened. "I can't blame you entirely. If I think about it, my tone last night was indeed wrong..."
"How good can you make someone who is jealous of you?"
How dare you embarrass her! Puning lightly beat his chest. "Who do you think you're talking to?"
He looked at her and smiled. "Of course I'm talking to my good princess, my good wife."
Talkative! Puning blushed and turned away, and he immediately reached out to wrap his arms around her.
Chapter 9(2)
"Stop being angry with me?"
"Let's talk." She looked at him, her eyes full of amorous feelings.
"What do you need to do to forgive me?" His face was very close.
"Is this——"
He saw her dark eyes turning in circles, and before she could spit out the answer, he suddenly kissed her with his lips.
"You think about it slowly, I'll do what I want to do first." He murmured against her, and when she followed the instructions, he slowly inserted his tongue.
It would be dark when she thought of the way to punish him.
She hugged him, moaning in ecstasy with each of his delicate explorations. She seriously thought that she would never taste his kiss again in this life...
A tear of gratitude overflowed from her eyes, and he licked it away with his tongue, then hugged her tightly.
"Don't cry." He nuzzled her cheek. "You are suitable for laughing. You don't know. Every time I see you cry, my heart hurts."
"I cried with joy." She looked at him with hazy and sweet eyes. "I'm so happy that we can resolve the misunderstanding. I'm so happy that you don't fall in love with Huo Xiang. I'm so happy to hear you call me my wife..."
"If you like to hear it, I will shout it to you every day." He pressed his lips to her ear and whispered again and again: "My wife, my little Ping'er..."
"One more thing." She grabbed his sleeve. "I want you to say it again."
He knew which sentence it was, and the tough man blushed.
"I like you, you should have known it as early as the moment I kissed you."
"It was very early." She couldn't help but say: "The night we were in the cave, you took advantage of me to feed you water and kissed me until I was wet."
Is there such a thing? ! His face heated up. "Then... probably by that time, I will like you."
Puningle fainted.
"Me too. From that night on, I really like you." She rubbed her face against his chest. "In the past, Long Yan said that I would definitely meet the person I like, but I still didn't believe it. Now I finally know that he was right. It feels so good to like someone and be liked by them -"
He couldn't help but ask: "Who is Long Yan?"
"It's the 'one dragon' in front of the gate of Jingli City -" she answered without thinking much, but when she saw his narrowed eyes, she immediately shut up, feeling as if she smelled jealousy? !
"When did he say this to you?"
"Once my father asked him to come into the palace to cook a meal, I had a chat with him..."
"He's very handsome?" How could a cook holding a ladle be able to talk to the princess without any arrangement? Yu Jiyou's expression was very unpleasant.
"Well..." How should I answer? Long Yan and him, one is handsome and the other is tough, both of them are very good-looking in different ways.
"You are not allowed to think about him in your mind!"He bit her mouth hatefully.
"I can't even think about it. I don't know who said before that he would bring a woman with him..." She deliberately teased him.
"I said I was sorry."
"You finally know how uncomfortable it feels to eat, right?" It wasn't until he nodded dissatisfied that she smiled and hugged his neck. "Don't worry, as a wife, my whole heart is with my husband. I won't talk about the past, but I promise that from now on, I will never look at any man again."
"I won't give you a chance to see. From now on, your people, your heart and your eyes are all mine. You are not allowed to say anything about breaking off the engagement and marrying someone else."
